# hetznerrobot_subnets (Data Source)

Lists the subnets of the account, or of one server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The subnets of one server; leave server_ip out for the whole account.
data "hetznerrobot_subnets" "web" {
  server_ip = "123.123.123.123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of a server; only its subnets are listed.

### Read-Only

- `subnets` (Attributes List) The subnets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `failover` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is a failover subnet.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway of the subnet.
- `ip` (String) Net address of the subnet.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the subnet is locked.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server the subnet is routed to.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the subnet belongs to.
- `traffic_daily` (Number) Daily traffic limit in MB.
- `traffic_hourly` (Number) Hourly traffic limit in MB.
- `traffic_monthly` (Number) Monthly traffic limit in GB.
- `traffic_warnings` (Boolean) Whether Robot sends traffic warnings.
